hero.title: File:Japanese cruiser Haguro at Rabaul.jpg
hero.credit: Official U.S. Army Air Force photograph NH 95558, from the collections of the U.S. Naval Historical Center [1].
hero.description:
Aircraft of the USAAF 3rd Bomb Group attack Japanese ships in Simpson Harbor, 2 November 1943.

The heavy cruiser Haguro is in the foreground. She had been somewhat damaged during the battle of Empress Augusta Bay the previous night. The burning transport at right appears to be one of the Hakone Maru class, of which Hakone Maru, Hakozaki Maru and Hakusan Maru were still afloat at the time. The ship in the left distance, partially hidden by smoke, appears to be the submarine tender Chogei or Jingei.

gallery.title: File:Rabaul under air attack.jpg
gallery.description: Rabaul under air attack by B-25's of ComAirSols Bomber Command. This strategic town became the vortex of attention for south and southwest Pacific planners in 1942 and early 1943. Lakunai, one of Rabaul's five airdromes, lies on the peninsula at the top center of this picture.

gallery.title: File:Rabaul under attack in November 1943.jpeg
gallery.description: Strike photograph taken by U.S. Navy Photographer's Mate First Class P.T. Bartnett (inset) showing Japanese ships under attack at Rabaul on 8 November 1943. Shortly after taking this image, he was killed in action after the TBF Avenger in which he was flying was hit by enemy fire.

gallery.title: File:80-G-89098 Carrier strike on Rabaul, 5 November 1943.jpg
gallery.artist: Presumed official USN or IJN photographer
gallery.description:
Title: Carrier strike on Rabaul, 5 November 1943
Caption: Japanese ships under carrier plane attack in Simpson Harbor. Cruiser with big fire aft is MAYA (left center). Several other cruisers are among the ships heading for sea, to the right. View looks north, with Rabaul town at top center and Lakunai airfield in top right. Photographed from a USS SARATOGA (CV-3) plane.

gallery.artist: Presumed official USN or IJN photographer
gallery.description:
Title: Carrier strike on Rabaul, 5 November 1943
Caption: Japanese ships in Simpson Harbor as U.S. carrier planes attack. Several heavy and light cruisers are present. Burning cruiser at left is MAYA. Cruiser with explosion forward, in center, is probably TAKAO. Photographed from a USS SARATOGA (CV-3) TBF. View looks east, with Matupi Island in center and South Daughter crater beyond.
